title: PDX private job results list v1 (Phase 1 additive)
description: Exact body for GET /internal/v1/jobs/{job_id}/results. Additive; does not mutate status v1. Semantics locked by service validation + contract tests (not fully expressible in JSON Schema alone): (1) at most one item per kind; (2) every item.job_id MUST equal envelope.job_id; (3) array order is non-semantic — consumers MUST select by kind; (4) incomplete jobs return results=[] with HTTP 200 (contrast GET /result which returns 404 RESULT_NOT_READY). GET /result remains the Farpals-stable single-item view preferring materialized_source. Bytes never appear on this wire. Derived/render byte retrieval is Phase 3.

results.description: At most one item per kind (max two kinds). Order is non-semantic.
